chunks: From him, from one of our companions, it reached Jabir al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever wears yellow sandals will not cease to look with delight as long as they are on him, because Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'Yellow is its color, giving delight to the beholders.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual or emotional benefit of wearing yellow sandals according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) links the aesthetic pleasure of yellow sandals to the Quranic description of the cow in Surah Al-Baqarah, illustrating the Shia scholarly tradition of deriving legal and spiritual insights from linguistic nuances (tafsir al-lugha). This hadith highlights the concept of *tazayyun* (adornment) in daily life, suggesting that permissible beautification can serve as a source of continuous spiritual and emotional contentment for the believer.

en.hubeali: From him, form one of our cmpanions, delivered to him by Jabir Al Ju’fy,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The one who wears yellow sandals, would not cease to be in delight for as long as they are upon him, because Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [2:69] its colour is yellow, giving delight to the beholders’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from certain persons of our people who received from Jabir al-Juhfiy who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one wears yellow shoes he continues in happiness as long as he wears that shoes; Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, says, “It is yellow which is delightful to the on-lookers.” [2:69]*’”
